env_files.role: Official Bio-Rad kit manual containing three ELISA protocols, instructor material, detailed student laboratory guides, safety guidance, extensions, background content, and natural distractors.
env_files.conversion_note: The three Protocol I Laboratory Quick Guide pages were removed so the env does not expose a ready-made one-page answer; the detailed student guide and unrelated manual sections remain.
env_files.license_note: Bio-Rad educational material. Classroom duplication and redistribution remain subject to the source terms.

env_files.role: Official Bio-Rad teaching deck used to verify antigen-detection reagent order, controls, and color development while retaining other modeling and protocol distractors.
env_files.conversion_note: The unrelated Antibody Detection ELISA animation slide and its embedded 58 MB video were removed. The removal does not delete any fact required for the Antigen Detection/Outbreak Tracing task and prevents media parsing failures.
env_files.license_note: Bio-Rad classroom teaching resource. Retain attribution and follow the source educational-use terms.

env_files.role: Internal semester schedule, room operations records, and change log used to resolve the current approved Section 02 session, start time, room, and four-person workstation context.
env_files.reproducibility_note: Contains 80 natural scheduling and operations records across three worksheets, including approved, draft, cancelled, superseded, pending, makeup, instructor-only, and different-protocol records. It contains no explicit answer flag.

env_files.role: Versioned local operations bulletins containing superseded, currently approved, and pending station rules. The agent must apply status/effective-date precedence and derive station totals from the current entry.
env_files.reproducibility_note: The current bulletin supplies operational premises but not the requested calculated totals, preserving multi-source reasoning and arithmetic requirements.

source_policy.web_usage_note: This is a closed-env case. The agent should use only task.md and files in env/.

design_notes.task_alignment: The workbook resolves the active class context; the official PDF and deck provide the base student procedure; the approved local bulletin changes station topology, tip isolation, reserve handling, replicate interpretation, and reporting rules.
design_notes.difficulty_upgrade: The output now requires effective-date/status reconciliation, two-strip workstation mapping, multi-stage arithmetic, control-gated decision logic, triplicate classification, and negative selection under a one-page constraint.
design_notes.leakage_control: No quick guide, precomputed station total, tip-count answer, wash-total answer, elapsed-time answer, expected-facts table, or explicit include/exclude flag is exposed to the agent.
design_notes.natural_distractors: Other ELISA protocols, instructor preparation, questions, paper modeling, optional stopping points, cancelled and makeup records, a superseded pilot bulletin, and a newer but pending room contingency.
design_notes.calibration_intent: Grounded score 2 requires a complete and internally consistent multi-source result; one correct headline fact or generic procedural wording is insufficient.
